_comment: Kollab OSS label taxonomy v1. Source of truth for every OSS agent. Creating/editing these labels on GitHub is a mutation: propose as a batch, apply only on human approval. Existing GitHub defaults are KEPT (bug, enhancement, documentation, question, duplicate, invalid, wontfix, good first issue, help wanted) because the issue templates and contributors already use them.

rules.priority: exactly one once triaged (none while needs-triage)
rules.area: one or more; at least one once triaged
rules.status: at most one, except needs-triage which is removed when triage completes
rules.platform: optional, only when the problem is platform-specific

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Something is broken (fix:)

labels.name: enhancement
labels.description: New feature or improvement (feat:)

labels.name: documentation
labels.description: Docs only (docs:)

labels.name: question
labels.description: Support or usage question, not a defect

labels.name: performance
labels.description: Speed, memory, or resource use (perf:)

labels.name: security
labels.description: Security hardening or vulnerability fix (security:). Report holes privately per SECURITY.md

labels.name: testing
labels.description: Tests, flaky tests, test infrastructure (test:)

labels.name: chore
labels.description: CI, build, refactor, tooling, release plumbing (ci:/build:/refactor:/chore:)

labels.name: priority/p0
labels.description: Critical: outage, data loss, security exposure, or broken release. Drop everything

labels.name: priority/p1
labels.description: High: major regression or blocker, no reasonable workaround. Next release

labels.name: priority/p2
labels.description: Normal: real, actionable, has a workaround. Planned work

labels.name: priority/p3
labels.description: Low: nice-to-have, polish, or long-term idea. Backlog

labels.name: needs-triage
labels.description: New; a maintainer has not evaluated it yet (applied by issue templates)

labels.name: status/needs-info
labels.description: Waiting on the reporter for specific details

labels.name: status/needs-repro
labels.description: Bug without steps someone else can follow

labels.name: status/accepted
labels.description: Triaged and accepted; ready to be picked up

labels.name: status/ready-for-agent
labels.description: Fully specified; a coder agent can take it via koordinator

labels.name: status/ready-for-human
labels.description: Needs human judgment, design, credentials, or manual testing

labels.name: status/blocked
labels.description: Waiting on another issue, PR, or external decision (name it in a comment)

labels.name: status/stale
labels.description: No qualifying activity for 45 days; closure proposed to a human

labels.name: status/no-stale
labels.description: Exempt from stale sweeps

labels.name: area/hub
labels.description: Hub mesh, identities, membership, relay, vaults, cron

labels.name: area/acp
labels.description: ACP harnesses and backends (Claude, Codex, ...)

labels.name: area/engine
labels.description: kollabor-engine HTTP/socket service, sessions, attach

labels.name: area/webui
labels.description: kollabor-webui frontend

labels.name: area/tui
labels.description: Terminal UI, input, rendering

labels.name: area/agent
labels.description: Agent runtime, tools, bundles, skills, queue

labels.name: area/llm
labels.description: Providers, profiles, OAuth, model/effort pickers, fallback

labels.name: area/conversation
labels.description: History, compaction, resume, goals

labels.name: area/voice
labels.description: kollabor-voice runtime and devices

labels.name: area/mobile
labels.description: PhoneLink, phone app, mobile builds

labels.name: area/ci
labels.description: GitHub workflows, test infrastructure, release pipeline

labels.name: platform/windows
labels.description: Windows-only behavior

labels.name: platform/macos
labels.description: macOS-only behavior

labels.name: platform/linux
labels.description: Linux-only behavior

labels.name: duplicate
labels.description: Same root cause as another OPEN item (cite it)

labels.name: invalid
labels.description: Not a Kollab problem, spam, or a test submission

labels.name: wontfix
labels.description: Will not be actioned (human decision only)

labels.name: good first issue
labels.description: Small, well-specified, good for newcomers

labels.name: help wanted
labels.description: Maintainers welcome an outside contribution

labels.name: regression
labels.description: Worked in an earlier release

labels.name: breaking-change
labels.description: Changes user-visible behavior or config; needs a changelog note
